title: Verifox Email Verifier
description: Bulk-verify email deliverability with Verifox. Bring your own Verifox API key.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to verify. Paste a list, or map in a field from another Actor's dataset.

apiKey.sectionDescription: No key yet? **[Create one free at verifox.ai/dashboard/api →](https://verifox.ai/dashboard/api)** — free signup includes 1,000 credits. Verifications run on your own Verifox account and use your credits.
apiKey.title: Verifox API key
apiKey.description: Paste your Verifox API key. Get it at https://verifox.ai/dashboard/api

mode.title: Verification mode
mode.description: auto = pick per list size (bulk when > 500). realtime = one request per email, streamed. bulk = submit the whole list to the Verifox bulk API, then collect results.

concurrency.title: Concurrency (realtime mode)
concurrency.description: How many emails to verify in parallel in realtime mode (1–20). Higher is faster but uses your credits quicker.

apiBaseUrl.title: API base URL (advanced)
apiBaseUrl.description: Override the Verifox API base URL. Leave as default unless told otherwise.
